scope: Actual bundled decoder, ProjectStore and compiler model in inherited mock DOM. Real browser/device acceptance is separate.

results.name: Recognized native ROM produces immutable evidence without touching active project, playback or history
ROM snapshot is copied before async hashing and exported projects are isolated
Recovery reads all native nametable, attributes, palettes and planar CHR bytes exactly
Native cell collision is exact and uniform tiles remain editable through ordinary tile properties
Identical tile art with different native collision gets exact cell overrides without invented global meaning
Pulse timers map exactly to canonical notes, constant instrument and frame duration without invented SFX
Unsupported cartridge headers, sizes and extensions reject atomically
Unknown code fingerprint and changed interrupt vectors never create a recovery project
Malformed collision and lossy palette values reject rather than normalize into plausible data
Unsupported body geometry and solid spawn fail before mutation
Unsupported and ambiguous pulse timers reject instead of guessing a pitch
Unsupported audio count, duration, envelope and sweep reject atomically
Successful import is an undoable replacement with byte-identical original and validated native project
Ordinary JSON save/reload preserves native assets, exact collision, music and original ROM
Forged stages and unavailable hashing reject with active state intact
Shared-memory inputs reject before hashing instead of claiming a coherent immutable snapshot
